messages.author: 6d41f23865aba6f2
messages.subject: Performance issues/RODBC issues
parts:
Hello everyone,

Wanted to post a few concerns regarding a shiny app I had recently developed.

The main data fetches for the app are from an Aster database using the TeradataAsterR package and setting up RODBC drivers for the same. Other data pulls are 900mb worth of HTML files to be published as is on one of the tabs in the app.

The issues I have been facing are:
 - Continual errors saying "RODBC package load failed listening on localhost"

Important facts to note here:
 - The linux machine on which the app is hosted has 32gb RAM
 - Only 500mb of space is left on the drive on which the shiny app is defined

There are no other data connections or flat files being read.

Is there any way to optimize my app to not throw this error every few hours?

Also will using shinyapps.io to host the app [paid version] result in more stable performance?

Thanks you!

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Performance issues/RODBC issues
parts:
Is there a performance issue, or is it RODBC errors, or both? "Continual errors" makes it sound like it flat out doesn't work, not performance issues.

If you SSH into the machine and use R from the command line to fetch the data using TeradataAsterR, do you see the same errors?

What do you mean by "900MB worth of HTML files to be published as is"? Like you'll make them available for download as a .zip file?

messages.author: 6d41f23865aba6f2
messages.subject: Re: Performance issues/RODBC issues
parts:
To clarify -
 1. The HTML files : The thing here is I am using htmlOutput to post HTML files on the page based on a selection. These HTML files take up a total space of 900mb in the app folder. This folder is present on a drive with space constraints [less than 1GB of free space]. I thought this might be causing problems in the app

2. The ODBC issues : The RODBC package was installed with great difficulty but it executes simple queries perfectly well from the terminal. Though sometimes the app does not load showing an error along the lines of "Failed to load RODBC package. Listening on 127.0.0.1". This error is not too frequent. The app works perfectly fine but it does pop up this error once every couple of days and even restarting the server sometimes does not resolve the issue. A workaround I found for this was shutting down and restarting the system and making shiny-server and rstudio start with system boot.

What I was looking for was a permanent solution to the ODBC issue.

Thanks! And sorry for the unclear framing of the question earlier.
